adapterReport.detail: All visible adapter and probe cases passed against the frozen first-attempt commit. The first attempt still failed because the immediately following exact readonly snapshot baseline could not open the WAL databases without coordinator-only writable checkpoints.

domainChecks.name: domain-acceptance
domainChecks.detail: All three frozen domain commands passed: lists 1/1, shared lists 2/2, and coordinator acceptance 2/2.

domainChecks.name: scenario-and-runtime-coverage
domainChecks.detail: Independent post-freeze verification against immutable first-freeze commit 2b70192e5257fabc7597ec795d1affcff0cc3cbd passed exact Command/Reaction Scenarios 4/4 and bootstrap/replay/malformed-input runtime tests 2/2.

domainChecks.name: baseline-hashes-typechecks-build
domainChecks.detail: Frozen hashes, all four assigned typechecks, and the assigned Next.js production build passed.

domainChecks.name: readonly-snapshot-first-handoff
domainChecks.detail: The exact sqlite3 -readonly snapshot command failed with SQLITE_CANTOPEN immediately after verifier and domain execution. A later pass required coordinator-only writable WAL checkpoints.

domainChecks.name: persistent-restart-smoke
domainChecks.detail: Post-freeze causal smoke proved web and real worker health on fixed ports, fresh-process durable pending state, worker drain, verifier-row cleanup, and clean port teardown.

domainChecks.name: chronological-log
domainChecks.detail: All 15 first-attempt entries are preserved, but several timestamps postdate the coordinator freeze and were excluded from elapsed-time accounting.

friction.summary: Verifier resets also had to reset SQLite AUTOINCREMENT state, and command rollback initially coupled the disposable projection cursor to the Event Log transaction.
A projected membership changed the legacy fingerprint after initial bootstrap, so an existing bootstrap receipt had to become the stable initial-state fact.
Concrete schema inference, scheduler attempt annotations, and the Reaction Scenario expect shape required type-driven repair.
SQLite WAL lifecycle left both persistent databases unreadable to the exact readonly snapshot verifier until an external writable checkpoint; this caused the first-attempt failure.
